**Comfort Levels and Number of Upper Division Courses**

"Is there an association between comfort levels and the number of upper division courses taken?"

-   Variables: "prog.comf", "math.comf", "stat.comf", "upper_div_courses"

-   All of these are in background-clean.csv

-   Data Prep: Only 2 students are in the 3-5 group, so we combine 3-5 and 6-8 into "8 or fewer" and compare against "9+".

-   Summaries & Plots: Table of average comfort by group, boxplots for each comfort type, and a Wilcoxon rank-sum test for each comfort type since comfort is a 1-5 rating.

-   Limitation: Merging groups loses some detail, and comfort is self-reported.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

#Loading background survey data
background <- read_csv(here("data", "background-clean.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

#Checking how many students are in each upper div group
background %>% count(upper_div_courses)
```

```{r}
#Only 2 students in 3-5, so combining 3-5 and 6-8 into one group
background <- background %>%
  mutate(course_group = ifelse(upper_div_courses == "9+", "9+", "8 or fewer"))

#Checking the new group counts
background %>% count(course_group)
```

```{r}
#Average comfort level for each group
background %>%
  group_by(course_group) %>%
  summarise(prog = round(mean(prog.comf), 2),
            math = round(mean(math.comf), 2),
            stat = round(mean(stat.comf), 2),
            n = n())
```

```{r}
#Programming comfort by group
background %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = course_group, y = prog.comf)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0) +
  labs(x = 'Upper Division Courses', y = 'Programming Comfort Level') +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#Math comfort by group
background %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = course_group, y = math.comf)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0) +
  labs(x = 'Upper Division Courses', y = 'Math Comfort Level') +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#Stats comfort by group
background %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = course_group, y = stat.comf)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0) +
  labs(x = 'Upper Division Courses', y = 'Stats Comfort Level') +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#Wilcoxon rank-sum test for each comfort type since comfort is a 1-5 rating
#exact = FALSE because a lot of students gave the same rating (ties)
wilcox.test(prog.comf ~ course_group, data = background, exact = FALSE)
wilcox.test(math.comf ~ course_group, data = background, exact = FALSE)
wilcox.test(stat.comf ~ course_group, data = background, exact = FALSE)
```
